minimalPlan: After OS maintenance, reuse/update the existing Moonlight Qt client if installed; otherwise use official packaged distribution such as com.moonlight_stream.Moonlight. Preserve pairing material in cog profile; no Sunshine host role or compute/model groups needed on Milly.

Keep existing fleet source/ABI intact. Host Lyrical/Python3.14 developer tools stay outside repo .venv and PYTHONPATH; repo tooling follows source Python3.13. Python3.15 is not a published Lyrical baseline.

Install only client-side decoder/graphics diagnostics through the OS-maintenance owner if missing. Verify Intel VAAPI codec support and actual decoder use after desktop login; do not assume support from CPU model.

Once ASUS owner returns RESOURCE_DONE, resolve enrolled endpoint addresses and allow only exact required management admission under existing fleet policy; then pair Moonlight to existing ASUS/Spark Sunshine host and exercise chosen desktop app.
Keep optional endpoint flags false for required release/quorum/compute/DDS. Do not run whole-fleet install/build/operator-launch on Milly.

Native local VIGIL UI is optional future work: preserve matching Jazzy CPython3.12 container, exact candidate message generation/install overlay plus UI/display/vigil_c2/vigil_utils and transitive dependencies. Validate Qt graphics access and ABI there before any owner-approved production-domain42 use.

Do not interpret host Lyrical installation as permission to import old Jazzy extensions into Python3.14 or to widen requires-python. A Lyrical VIGIL port requires source, lock, message ABI and integration evidence in an owned change.

validationPlan.notRun: No local tests executed in this source-only lane; no rendering/input/DDS acceptance claimed.

Optional endpoint tests must bind corrected optional tree, not this base checkout.
negativeControls: Reject forbidden quorum/compute or malformed optional profile; preserve exactly3 required production members.
UI static wiring tests detect nonexistent imported messages, missing console entrypoints and broken resource paths.
Foxglove hermetic dry-run tests reject invalid host/domain/ports without SSH or live bridge.
If native container chosen: ABI/import smoke in networknone/domain231, Qt offscreen fixture with actual output sentinel, and missing overlay/type mismatch must fail.
validationPlan.postMaintenanceHIL: Owner-coordinated real stream after RESOURCE_DONE: record source and client versions, codec/resolution/fps/bitrate, route, decoder identity, frame drops/latency and CPU/GPU use; test keyboard/mouse exact known effect plus reconnect/sleep. Blank image, software fallback and unavailable peer reported explicitly. Remote video does not establish physical projector or clinical acceptance.
